title: Maharashtra district reference indicators
source_note: User-supplied workbook; source publishers and update dates have not been independently authenticated.
temporal_scope: Cross-sectional snapshot. Reference years vary or are unspecified; fields do not share a common year.

quality_summary.interpretation: 35 local area rows (including Brihan Mumbai); six divisions and Maharashtra total excluded.
MPCB regions are not identical to administrative districts.
Office + region subtotal overlap; these are stocks / class counts, not verified monthly flows.
Domestic/international airport rows; section and grand totals excluded in comparisons.
2011 uses older boundaries; Palghar not separate in uploaded census source.

quality_rules.source_or_rule: Dataset files have different times, spatial units and subtotal rows. Comparisons must respect the notes below.
